name: kettlebell front rack walking lunge
description: Walking lunges with kettlebells held in the front rack position. Builds leg strength while the core works to keep you upright.
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the front rack, elbows tucked and close to your ribs.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Keep your torso upright and the bells steady against your chest.
Continue alternating legs for the planned distance.
